Do not collapse cross-promotion USER_KEY overlap rows; keep flags and avoid unique-user promotion language.

is_promotion is the top-level split variable; do not use it as a feature inside groupwise models.
Future model output should be repurchase_score; operational churn risk is later defined as 1 - repurchase_score.
Review columns from 05b remain excluded from conservative baseline candidates until resolved.
Forbidden/drop columns from 05b must not be used as features.
